FileSink.Description: File logging enabled for production. Disable in development if console output is sufficient. Production-ready: enabled by default with 100MB rolling files. Adjust Path as needed for deployment. Log rotation: FileSizeLimitMb caps individual log files at 100MB; MaxFileCount=10 keeps at most 10 rotated files. For centralized log aggregation in production, configure a log shipper (Fluentd, Logstash, Vector) tailing /var/log/fishmmo/*.log and forwarding to an external store (Elasticsearch, Loki, Grafana Cloud).
